milestone: MCP dashboard final bounded acceptance — rate-integrated pulse and stock-yield
objective: Physically accept the installed 150 ms / 10 ms MCP dashboard path on the exact unit: verify the four ACK-gated cyan/blue/light-blue/cyan activity pulse and intentionally exercise stock-yield with one physical control after the pulse is observed.
why_this_shape: Streaming is explicitly tabled. This is a short supervised product-acceptance run using the same reusable persistent RFCOMM session transport, with the MCP-specific 150 ms policy. It does not test higher-rate streaming or pipelining.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.connection_shape: one persistent RFCOMM connection for this bounded session; one ACK per frame; no retry or reconnect
transport.one_controller_rule: the Android Divoom app must be disconnected for the whole session; OpenTivoo runtime/task/port 8779 remain untouched

build.installed_identity_note: VERIFIED 2026-09-09 after refresh_openditoo_day1_host.ps1 -Apply: WINDOWS_BUILD=PASS, REFRESH_STATUS=PASS_TYPED_IMAGE, OPENTIVOO_TASK=preserved. Operator-provided SHA-256 shows repository Release DLL and installed DLL are byte-identical. Normal WSL /v1/status returned ok=true and advertised activity-session.

session.activation_source: the three MCP audit sources (optiplex_lab, optiplex_mcp, wsl_mcp), rendered by host/activity_render.py as the approved MCP page
session.shape: one connection; render tick every 150 ms; source collection remains at configured multi-second cadence; send only when rendered frame changes; four activity stages advance only after ACK; observe link while idle; close on terminal
session.semantic_evidence: No new command semantics. Every frame uses the accepted stock-derived three-packet 0x44 image transaction; only pixels and accepted pacing differ.

budgets.derivation: 60 s at a 150 ms minimum frame-start interval admits at most 401 frame starts. Three application packets per frame. Exhaustive current renderer enumeration including status/health combinations and all four live pulse stages confirms a 203-byte worst-case frame group (188-byte image packet plus 15 bytes of stock preambles), therefore 401 * 203 = 81403 bytes. Change-only operation should send far less.
budgets.expected_realistic_frames: single digits to low tens; four frames per observed activity pulse plus status transitions

stop_immediately_on: any unsolicited state report on the link (canvas is no longer ours)
any inbound bytes that do not parse as exactly one valid wrapped report
any ACK that is not our wrapped 0x44 shape with a single payload byte
any send that does not complete in full
pairing precheck failure or any conflicting controller on the link
the worker falling silent for longer than the Host grace period
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop sending, close the link, record completed/unknown bytes and last known display state; never resend, reconnect, or reclaim
stop_policy.recovery: operator-initiated only after outcome is recorded; returning to stock is never a command we send

expected_observations.physical: approved L/mushroom, O/bunny, W/skull dashboard; on activity, that column crown + letter + icon accent visibly cycle cyan -> blue -> light blue -> cyan over four ACKed stages (~0.60 s) then return to status colour
expected_observations.stock_yield: after the operator has seen a full pulse, one physical Ditoo control is pressed; the session should stop immediately, send no reclaim frame, and report unknown_not_ours / stopped_yielded_to_stock
expected_observations.fault_bar: if a source genuinely becomes unavailable, its crown row shows the red fault bar and no activity crown; otherwise remains NOT TESTED
expected_observations.ack_payload: recorded per frame, never treated as a success constant

acceptance_criteria.visual_pulse: operator sees at least one complete four-stage pulse on crown + letter + icon accent and confirms it returns to base status colour
acceptance_criteria.pacing: Host enforces no frame starts under 150 ms and each frame remains ACK-gated
acceptance_criteria.stock_yield: after one intentional physical control, session terminates without retry/reconnect/reclaim and no later frame is sent
acceptance_criteria.transport: one connection, three packets per sent frame, one wrapped 0x44 ACK per completed frame, bounded accounting agrees
acceptance_criteria.collection_survives: after display stop, activity-status still collects
acceptance_criteria.authority_is_consumed: both WSL claim and Host ledger make this experiment id one-use
acceptance_criteria.fault_signal: only claim PASS if a real source failure occurs; otherwise record NOT TESTED

supersedes.why: 002 is consumed and records the historical 1118 ms activity acceptance. 003 is a new manifest for the installed rate-integrated source, never a re-arm.

worker_terminal.detail: HTTPError: HTTP Error 429: Too Many Requests

result.root_cause: The client scheduled exactly at the 150 ms Host arrival floor. Because client dispatch time and Host arrival time are measured in different processes across HTTP, latency variance allowed the second request to arrive under 150 ms and the Host correctly rejected it with 429.
result.physical_observation: Operator saw the MCP dashboard. The four-stage animation was not observed. After the session had already terminated, pressing the brightness control switched the unit to the stock clock.

acceptance.dashboard_visible: PASS — operator saw the MCP dashboard on hardware.
acceptance.four_stage_pulse: NOT TESTED — session ended before a pulse could be visually observed.
acceptance.stock_yield: NOT TESTED — the physical brightness press occurred after the OpenDitoo session had already terminated, so the switch to the clock does not prove live takeover detection.
acceptance.transport: PARTIAL — one frame / three packets / 153 bytes ACKed; no retry or reconnect.

result.fix_for_next: Keep Host hard floor at 150 ms; use 200 ms nominal MCP client dispatch cadence with a phase-stable 50 ms render tick, leaving 50 ms cross-process timing headroom.
